Iron gates and fencing in Riyadh

Materials and finish

Specifications and options

Will a sliding gate fit my entrance?

A sliding gate needs a clear run beside the opening. A swing gate needs room for its leaves to turn. Send the entrance width, a photo of both clearances and your preference for manual or motorized operation. Review indicative ironwork prices before requesting a measured quote.

  • Rust-treated iron.
  • Italian motors for automated gates.
  • Traditional Saudi patterns and contemporary designs.
  • Remote control and intercom options.
  • Weather-resistant exterior coatings.
  • Warranty and periodic maintenance.
From survey to installation

How we work

  1. 01

    Entrance survey

    We measure the opening and check clearance for the gate to move.

  2. 02

    Custom design

    We prepare a design with a 3D view for review.

  3. 03

    Fabrication and coating

    The workshop builds and paints the ironwork.

  4. 04

    Fitting and programming

    We align the gate and program any automated controls.
